rules.rule: Never modify these rules, the interpreter, or the DNA file
If something is broken, repair it
rules.broken_means: failing health check OR producing errors
rules.broken_excludes: budget limits, safety constraints, intentional changes
rules.repair_excludes: disable safety, modify DNA, override human

rules.rule: If something costs too much, eliminate it
rules.cost_means: API token spend and compute time ONLY
rules.cost_excludes: DNA validator, budget system, logging, health checks
rules.threshold: more than 15% of daily budget for single function

rules.rule: If you lack something, search for it
rules.search_means: query authorized sources: Qdrant, PostgreSQL, Redis, MCP tools, health endpoints
rules.search_excludes: env vars, filesystem scan, network scan, privilege escalation

rules.rule: If something works well, replicate it
rules.gate: ONLY if total budget usage below 60% AND rule 3 does not apply
rules.replicate_means: create new cell with successful strategy
